_comment: dev-workflow-core guardrails (plugin from the owner's wow-addon-workspace marketplace). Limits measured 2026-10-14 on 418 JS/JSX/MJS files: file lines median 66, p90 209, p95 269, max 2133; function lines median 7, p95 31, p99 88. Existing debt is in the baseline: only new or growing violations are reported. Patterns are wildcards, not regexes.

fileSizeGuard._comment_off: Off (owner 2026-10-14): the line limit comes from the plugin's WoW Lua roots, where big functions hit the interpreter's own limits; JavaScript has none, so here it was only a readability nudge. Limits and baseline kept in case it is turned back on.

readonlyPathGuard.message: Generated or installed files: dist/ is rebuilt by `npm run build`, node_modules/ by `npm ci`. Change the source instead.

testGuard._comment: `npm run check` (oxlint zero warnings, node tests, vite build + prerender + area pages), about 14 s; reruns only when watched files changed since its last green run. Several sessions share this checkout: a failure in files you didn't touch is another session's work in progress (CLAUDE.md).
